# peakhour_rp_firewall_settings (Resource)

Manages RP firewall settings for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_firewall_settings" "example" {
  domain               = "example.com"
  challenge_cookie_key = ["fingerprint_tls", "ip"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `challenge_cookie_key` (List of String) Challenge cookie key types (spec enum: fingerprint_tls, ip, session_id). Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP firewall settings identifier (domain/rp_firewall_settings).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_firewall_settings.example example.com
```
